summary: Native agent mailboxes merge graph and message-shard mail in canonical send order instead of placing every graph message before shard messages.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill. Existing pending mail uses canonical send order on its next mailbox update.

schema.detail: No published schema or contract digest change.

rules.detail: No authority, retention or claim-admission change.

compatibility.detail: Full native mailbox snapshots and incremental updates use the same canonical send keys across both stores. Ordinary deltas retain the key cache in place and reposition only changed messages; only full snapshot reads require full sorting. Index namespaces remain pagination identities, not delivery priority.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion.

recovery.detail: Existing receipt and recovery admission policies are unchanged.
